Welcome to ElectionGuide, the most comprehensive and timely source of verified election information available online. This database houses details on upcoming nationwide elections and referendums around the world. It includes data on electoral systems, political parties and candidates, and key issues at stake in each election. Here you can also find historical information on all national elections held since the database's creation in 1998.

To learn more about the creation and navigation of this resource, please visit our About Page.
